title: Solar AI rooftop condition top-up v1
subtitle: Phase 19-B first-party rooftop condition crops, AI-reviewed, domain top-up only
description: PRIVATE. AI-visually-reviewed (not owner-verified) CLEAN/DUSTY/BIRD_DROP/PHYSICAL_DAMAGE crops from one rooftop, 241 total, heavily skewed toward CLEAN. Too few/skewed to train a standalone classifier - meant to be mixed into the much larger solar-ai-ground-condition-4class-classifier-v1 (Susan-derived) training set for domain adaptation only.
